# metronome_rate (Resource)

A rate: the price of one product on one rate card, from a moment on.

~> **A rate card's rates are a schedule that is only ever added to.** Metronome has no call that edits or removes a rate, so:

* **Every attribute replaces the resource**: the old rate is dropped from the state and a new one added to the schedule.
* **To change a price, change `starting_at` with it.** The new rate takes over from its own `starting_at`; usage before that keeps the old price. A new rate with the *same* `starting_at` as an existing one is sent to Metronome as it is; what Metronome then does is not documented.
* **Destroying a rate removes it from the state and leaves it in Metronome**, with a warning. To stop charging for a product, add a rate with `entitled = false`.

A price in USD is in **cents**; fractions of a cent are allowed. Tiered commit rates, custom rates and percentage minimums are not supported by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# 20 cents an hour.
resource "metronome_rate" "awake" {
  rate_card_id = metronome_rate_card.standard.id
  product_id   = metronome_product.awake.id
  starting_at  = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
  entitled     = true
  rate_type    = "FLAT"
  price        = 20
}

# Free at list price and 28 cents against credit: usage draws credit down
# and costs nothing once it is gone.
resource "metronome_rate" "disk" {
  rate_card_id = metronome_rate_card.standard.id
  product_id   = metronome_product.disk.id
  starting_at  = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
  entitled     = true
  rate_type    = "FLAT"
  price        = 0
  commit_rate = {
    rate_type = "FLAT"
    price     = 28
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entitled` (Boolean) Whether customers on the rate card may use the product. `false` withdraws it: its usage is not charged.
- `product_id` (String) The product priced.
- `rate_card_id` (String) The rate card.
- `rate_type` (String) `FLAT` (a price per unit), `TIERED`, `PERCENTAGE` or `SUBSCRIPTION`.
- `starting_at` (String) From when the rate applies (RFC 3339, inclusive, on an hour boundary).

### Optional

- `billing_frequency` (String) For `SUBSCRIPTION`: `MONTHLY`, `QUARTERLY`, `ANNUAL` or `WEEKLY`.
- `commit_rate` (Attributes) A second price, used in place of the list price while usage is paid for from a commit or a credit that asks for it (`rate_type: COMMIT_RATE`). With a list `price` of 0 and the real price here, usage draws credit down while there is credit and costs nothing when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--commit_rate))
- `credit_type_id` (String) The pricing unit of the price. Defaults to USD (cents).
- `ending_before` (String) Until when the rate applies (RFC 3339, exclusive, on an hour boundary). Left out, until a later rate takes over.
- `is_prorated` (Boolean) For `SUBSCRIPTION`: whether a part period is charged in proportion.
- `price` (Number) For `FLAT` and `SUBSCRIPTION`: the price of one unit, in the pricing unit (USD: cents). For `PERCENTAGE`: a fraction, `0.1` for 10%.
- `pricing_group_values` (Map of String) For a product with a `pricing_group_key`: the values of the key this rate is for.
- `quantity` (Number) For `SUBSCRIPTION`: the default quantity.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) For `TIERED`: the tiers, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<rate_card_id>/<product_id>/<starting_at>`. Metronome gives rates no ID of their own.

<a id="nestedatt--commit_rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `commit_rate`

Required:

- `price` (Number) The price of one unit, in the pricing unit (USD: cents).
- `rate_type` (String) `FLAT`.


<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Required:

- `price` (Number) The price of one unit in the tier.

Optional:

- `size` (Number) How many units the tier holds. Left out on the last tier, which has no end.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import metronome_rate.awake f3d51ae8-f283-44e1-9933-a3cf9ad7a6fe/d7abd0cd-4ae9-4db7-8676-e986a4ebd8dc/2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
```
